scenes.title: *First time ever.*
scenes.say: The three most powerful men on Earth are about to meet in one room. For the first time ever.
scenes.display: The three most powerful men on Earth are about to meet in one room. For the first time ever.

scenes.title: APEC summit
scenes.say: They meet Thursday, at the A-peck summit in Shen-jen, China.
scenes.display: They meet Thursday, at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China.

scenes.title: Trump & Xi, *one-on-one*
scenes.say: Trump is expected to sit down with Shee first. Then Putin joins.
scenes.display: Trump is expected to sit down with Xi first. Then Putin joins.

scenes.title: The agenda? *Nobody's saying.*
scenes.say: The agenda? China hasn't said. But Trump has hinted at Ukraine, the war in Iran, and nuclear weapons.

scenes.title: Kim Jong-un?
scenes.say: And the wildcard? Trump says he might also meet Kim Jong-un in China. But that depends on Shee.
scenes.display: And the wildcard? Trump says he might also meet Kim Jong-un in China. But that depends on Xi.

scenes.title: *Nothing* is confirmed
scenes.say: But North Korea isn't even an A-peck member. And nothing is confirmed.
scenes.display: But North Korea isn't even an APEC member. And nothing is confirmed.
